description: The configuration the ACT binds to a source when its DataType is AGGREGATE_DATA. It controls the minimum number of matching rows required before an aggregate result is returned and how facet counts are post-processed.

suppressionThreshold.description: The minimum number of matching rows required before an aggregate result is returned. An aggregate query that matches a non-zero row count below this threshold is suppressed. Must be a positive value.

facetPostProcessingConfig.description: Configuration describing how facet counts are post-processed. Optional.
